A small number of commercial multi-modal bio-electric SoCs integrating ECG, EEG, EMG, and PPG front-ends around a RISC-V core have also become available. None of the prior art identified, however, combines monolithic ECG + EEG+PPG acquisition with a joint, on-chip cardiac-arrhythmia and seizure-onset classification path specifically targeted at a sub-30 nm Indian foundry route (Semiconductor Laboratory, Chandigarh) and an Indian rural/PHC deployment cost point; this combination is the specific architectural contribution of CardioNeural-SoC.

chunks.text: Cardiovascular and neurological disease together impose one of the largest preventable disease burdens in India, yet every application-specific integrated circuit used in the cardiac and neurological monitoring devices sold domestically is currently imported. This paper presents CardioNeural-SoC, an indigenous, mixed-signal System-on-Chip architecture designed to consolidate a 4-channel electrocardiogram (ECG) front-end, a 2-channel electroencephalogram (EEG) front-end, a photoplethysmography (PPG) interface, a 16-bit analog-to-digital converter array, a RISC-V-based digital signal processing core with hardware accelerators for arrhythmia and seizure-onset classification, an AES-128-secured Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE 5.3) interface, and an ultra-low-power management unit onto a single 28 nm CMOS die. 5. RTL Functional Verification
Full system-level functional verification was performed against tb_cardionearal_soc_top.v in Cadence Xcelium. The testbench exercises multi-channel ECG sample sequencing, multi-rate clock generation across the ECG/EEG/PPG analog domains, ADC/DAC conversion and comparator handshaking, the on-chip arrhythmia (AF) classification path, AES-128 encryption of the payload prior to BLE transmission, the BLE enable/encrypt-done/transmit-request/power-gate handshake sequence, and DC-DC converter enable sequencing at system start-up. Table 4 summarizes the verified functional groups; the full regression reported ALL 9 TEST CASES PASSED, with simulation completing via $finish at simulation time 219,473,130 ns.

8. Discussion
The principal contribution of this work is architectural and pre-silicon: a verified RTL implementation and a synthesized sub-block (layer1_top) demonstrating that the proposed multi-modal acquisition and on-chip classification architecture is implementable within a digital-logic budget consistent with the system-level power target in Table 3, once duty-cycling is applied. The zero-slack timing closure reported in Section 6.3 and the 46.06 mW worst-case synthesis-stage power figure for layer1_top both warrant continued attention during physical implementation: zero slack at the gate level typically requires either a relaxed clock period, pipeline restructuring, or further logic optimization once net parasitics are introduced at place-and-route, and the energy-accumulator block's power should be evaluated under its intended duty-cycled (rather than continuous) operating profile before being treated as representative of always-on power.
